_notes: Document review in the Agency console unified on 'pemeriksaan dokumen' / 'periksa' (queue, reviewer, shortcuts, blocks, issue status); 'tinjauan' stays for essay review and university review.

Stage names: 'Konseling' → 'Konsultasi' (glossary); 'Siap' → 'Siap diajukan' (matches common:appStatus.READY); university stage 'Received' was 'Diterima masuk', which collides with Admitted = 'Diterima' → 'Masuk'; 'In review' unified on 'Sedang ditinjau'; 'Arrived' unified on 'Sudah tiba'.
Reply owed (답장 대기) chips/sections unified on 'Perlu dibalas'.
Document vault: 'brankas dokumen' everywhere (three ws strings said 'penyimpanan dokumen').
Enrollment = 'pendaftaran ulang' (noun) and 'Terdaftar' (status); one string said 'registrasi' and two funnel steps said 'Mendaftar ulang'.
Mock interview = 'simulasi wawancara' (ws.apptHint said 'latihan wawancara'); Book consultation = 'Jadwalkan konsultasi' (was 'panggilan').
Standard admission letter: 'surat penerimaan standar (standard admission letter)' in ws.noVisaText and decision.certificateInfo.
'Funnel' rendered 'alur penerimaan' (no English calque); 'Yield' KPI rendered 'Konversi tawaran'; 'Insights' nav is 'Wawasan', so v28.pipe.label points there instead of 'Analitik'.
Service period = 'masa layanan' in the agency plan panel; 'masa kontrak' in marketing is the contract itself and was left.
Closed hints: 'ditolak atau mundur' → 'tidak diterima atau mengundurkan diri' to match common:appStatus.REJECTED and af.foot.
